meta.title: The 6 Best Fall Jackets! (+ 1 bonus). (Denim, leather, corduroy, etc!)
meta.description:
Ah yes, Fall jackets. Autumn jackets. Jackets for when it's actually getting a wee bit chilly in the air! It's the best time of year. A good jacket is the best. You can wear it and people will say "wow what a nice fall jacket!". That'd be amazing. Anyways put down your pumpkin spice latte from Dunkin' or Starbucks and get to watching!

Today we are looking at the best (imo) leather jackets from Taylor Stitch & Schott, the best raw selvedge denim jacket from Freenote Cloth, two amazing chore coats from Taylor Stitch (in herringbone and corduroy) and FINALLY A BONUS! From none other than the legendary Best Made Co. (bought by Duluth) and Dehen 1920. Ya just can't beat em! Pair them with some Red Wings, Levi's, and a nice big smile and you'll be good to go. Also if you want to go really New England you can grab some Bean Boots.

NEATO!

The Iron Snail is a men’s fashion vlog starring a young man named Michael and featuring a snail no bigger than a quarter. The two are set on taking over the world of fashion by creating a clothing line to end all clothing lines. Until then, we’re here to tell you EVERYTHING you need to know about the best clothing out there, from the highest quality raw denim jeans to the warmest jacket to the sturdiest boots…the Iron Snail has got you covered. (written by Taylor, though Michael is sometimes known to talk about himself in the third person… xoxo)
